assembly.scope: Closed finite CandidatePairsChecked theorem: every canonical first direction and every signed coordinate permutation of every canonical second direction has a verified dependence, coordinate, line obstruction, or exact critical-plane acceptance witness. The proof covers all 1,152,000 distinct vector pairs and all 720 index permutations through an independently checked coverage map. This finite theorem does not by itself prove the real-plane gap or discharge the five-speed classification input.

coverage.scope: All 10 canonical multisets and all 720 coordinate permutations are covered by the 360 positive vector rows for that multiset. Bounded rank checks are joined by a quotient/remainder proof. Generic pair-check chunk assembly is also checked; no complete pair enumeration or real-plane gap is claimed.

pattern-0.scope: All 115,200 finite signed-vector pairs with first canonical pattern 0: 10 second patterns, 360 positive vector permutations each, and 32 sign masks. Each of the 10 pair-pattern modules proves nine 40-row chunks and their complete row assembly. Other first patterns and the final closed theorem are separate jobs.
